clue.text: Upset? Depends how big-/ headed one is!

definitions.meaning: a boat that is upset has been turned over in the water

definitions.text: Depends how big-/ headed one is
definitions.meaning: the measurement of a hat, which varies with how large a person's head is

explanation.surface: A remark about conceited people and how easily they are put out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Big-headed' suggests vanity, but here it is literal: how big your head is fixes the hat you buy.
explanation.definitionFit: To overturn a vessel is to upset it; the second reading is the hat measurement, which follows head size.

indicators.note: the letters move away from what they were, so the two words are reshuffled

explanation.surface: A crossword hint that is anything but precise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from being' signals that CLUEFAR is no longer itself: rearrange it.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone meticulous takes great pains, which is the core sense of the adjective.

clue.text: Brilliant spectacle opening up over Etna, perhaps

indicators.note: in a down answer the first piece sits above the second
in a down clue the word is read upwards, so its letters run backwards
suggests the volcano's name may be rearranged into another form

explanation.surface: A dazzling sight of the volcano erupting, its crater opening up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Etna, perhaps' looks like an example of a spectacle, but it is anagram fodder; 'up' turns the gap word backwards in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A showy procession or tableau is a grand display put on for viewers.

clue.text: Ground has a tenant, it seems

definitions.meaning: a patch of land, here a tiny island
a rented property '...', and run together those two words make the answer

explanation.surface: A plot of land that turns out to be rented.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading splits the answer as IS LET; 'it seems' admits the pun.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiny island is a patch of land; and a property with a tenant is rented out.

definitions.meaning: to develop a plan in detail

explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it means intricate; as a verb it means to develop something in greater detail.

clue.text: They took over from the night-shift

definitions.text: They took over from the night-shift

parts.words: They took over from the night-shift
parts.note: the night-shift is read as the nightdress worn in bed, which was replaced by a two-piece sleeping suit

explanation.definitionFit: Two-piece sleepwear came into fashion in place of the older nightshirt or nightgown.

clue.text: They may be well-worn and well-used

definitions.meaning: light dancing or plimsoll-type shoes are worn on the feet
devices used at a well to raise water

explanation.definitionFit: Light shoes are worn; machines that lift water are used at a well.

clue.text: Scrap areas where ships are built in Hong Kong?

definitions.meaning: places where discarded metal and rubbish is stored

definitions.text: where ships are built in Hong Kong?
definitions.meaning: Chinese sailing ships are junks, so their shipyards would be yards for junks

explanation.definitionFit: Places holding scrap; and, read in two parts, yards building Chinese sailing vessels.

clue.text: Book covering part of N. Africa

definitions.meaning: a fine goatskin leather used for bookbinding

explanation.definitionFit: The leather used in bookbinding shares its name with the north-west African country.

clue.text: Hardy type shows skill in bridge

indicators.note: places the word for skill within the word for bridge

parts.note: a span is a bridge or the arch of one
art is skill, as in the art of fencing

explanation.surface: A tough character displays his ability at the card table.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hardy' suggests the novelist Thomas Hardy, and 'bridge' the card game.
explanation.definitionFit: A person from ancient Sparta was famed for austere toughness, so a hardy type.

indicators.note: the letters are made from the country's name by rearranging them

explanation.surface: Crown jewels brought over from North Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' tells you to build the answer out of ALGERIA's letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Crowns, sceptres and orbs are the emblems of monarchy.

explanation.surface: A collier pitted against a deity.
explanation.definitionFit: The Roman deity of wisdom and crafts.

parts.note: vulgar here is the arithmetic sense, as in a top-over-bottom number, and 'not all' says these are parts of a whole

explanation.definitionFit: Numbers written as a part of a whole are called vulgar (common) when written as numerator over denominator.

indicators.note: a rocking movement shakes the woman's name into a new order

explanation.surface: A woman making waves on board.
explanation.definitionFit: A sailing vessel used for pleasure or racing is a kind of boat.

clue.text: A deal with America for plant

parts.note: a lot, as in a great deal

explanation.surface: A business agreement struck with the United States over a plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A deal' looks like a business agreement but means 'a lot', a large amount.
explanation.definitionFit: A water lily of Asia, a well-known flowering plant.

indicators.note: suggests the phrase may take another form when its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A building plot that looks like a rundown district.
explanation.definitionFit: To imitate or feign the appearance of something is to look like it.

clue.text: P.M. comes out of No. Ten for a break

indicators.note: the phrase is broken up and its letters rebuilt

explanation.surface: The Prime Minister leaves Downing Street for a holiday.
explanation.walkthrough: 'P.M.' looks like the Prime Minister, and No. Ten his Downing Street home; it means post meridiem. 'break' rearranges NOTENFORA.
explanation.definitionFit: The abbreviation post meridiem marks the hours after midday.

clue.text: A blow in an attempt to achieve parity

definitions.text: A blow in an attempt to achieve parity

parts.words: A blow in an attempt to achieve parity
parts.note: a retaliatory strike struck back to even the score

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means retaliation in kind, a hit returned for a hit.

parts.note: in the Church a living is a parish post, and the man holding it is its present holder

explanation.definitionFit: The holder of a church benefice, or any office, is its present occupant.

clue.text: Reveals I have a thousand shares

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand

explanation.surface: A shareholder announces a large stake.
explanation.definitionFit: To pass on or disclose information is to reveal it.

clue.text: Small bird needs tail bent when in bed

indicators.note: places the rearranged letters within the bed word

parts.note: a cot is a small bed

indicators.note: a bent tail is twisted out of shape, so its letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A tiny bird folds its tail when roosting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bed' tempts as a flower bed or nest; it is a cot, round the reshuffled tail ('bent', 'when in').
explanation.definitionFit: A small black-capped titmouse of woodland and gardens.

definitions.meaning: one of the five senses, vision

explanation.definitionFit: A spectacle seen; and the faculty of vision, one of the five senses.

parts.note: the go-signal that lets a project begin

explanation.definitionFit: A green light or approval to proceed with something.

indicators.note: suggests the word is made new by rearranging it

explanation.definitionFit: A frame of legs holding up a board or table top is a support.

clue.text: A gem looks right in a ring

indicators.note: places the letter inside the bell word

parts.note: a peal is a ring of bells

explanation.surface: A jewel that looks perfect set into a ring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a ring' suggests jewellery; it is a peal of bells. 'looks' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A lustrous jewel formed inside an oyster is a gem.

parts.note: bars suggests pubs, but it is a confection sold in slabs and also a hot drink

explanation.definitionFit: Cocoa made into a hot drink, and the confection sold in slabs.

parts.note: a golfer's helper who carries the clubs, not a doorman at a club

explanation.definitionFit: A golfer's attendant carries the bag of clubs round the course.

clue.text: Cat required-there are quite a few in the pound

definitions.text: there are quite a few in the pound
definitions.meaning: sixteen of these weights make a pound avoirdupois

explanation.definitionFit: The snow leopard; and a unit of weight, sixteen to the pound.

indicators.note: the letters are put into a new order

explanation.surface: Switched to a different line of business.
explanation.definitionFit: Spun round on an axis, so turned.

parts.note: an outside telephone line is suggested, but it is a straight line touching a circle from outside

explanation.definitionFit: In geometry, a straight line that touches a circle at one point without cutting it.

indicators.note: the letters are made into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone who stays only if kept happy.
explanation.definitionFit: To make someone content is to please or fulfil them.

parts.note: down-trodden suggests an oppressed labourer, but it is a foot pedal literally trodden down to drive a machine

explanation.definitionFit: A foot lever pressed down to drive a sewing machine or lathe.
